key_insight: GRPO outperforms supervised fine-tuning for synthetic-speech-only ASR adaptation, cutting WER far more effectively by optimizing behavior directly.
engineering_relevance: For regulated domains like banking where real speech is scarce or constrained, reinforcement learning offers a stronger path than SFT for leveraging synthetic TTS data in ASR systems.
method: Adapt an LLM-based ASR model using synthetic TTS speech only
Use critic-free GRPO with a low-WER reward signal
Compare GRPO against SFT and an SFT-then-GRPO pipeline
evidence_signal: On synthetic speech, GRPO reduced WER from 36.71% to 22.09% relative to SFT, and the combined SFT-then-GRPO setup achieved an even larger 45% reduction.
watch_item: The gains come from synthetic-only adaptation, so real-world robustness and domain transfer should still be validated before deployment.
paper_title: When Synthetic Speech Is All You Have: Better Call GRPO
